IDLE.D: slow restrained float + subtle breathe; calm neutral gaze
IDLE.E: slightly more buoyant float + small directional sway; neutral-curious gaze

LISTEN.D: small forward/orient lean + gaze hold toward learner
LISTEN.E: small directional tilt toward learner + gaze hold

THINK.D: slight inward compression + counter-tilt + gaze offset + slower blink
THINK.E: small counter-tilt + reduced buoyancy + gaze offset + slower blink

SPEAK.D: stable explain orientation + small ribbon pulse + audio-driven mouth
SPEAK.E: slightly more directional explain tilt + bounded pulse + audio-driven mouth

CORRECT.D: calm supportive orientation + soft brow + small mouth + reduced motion
CORRECT.E: energy damped + gentle tilt + soft brow + small mouth

later_states.GREETING: use orientation/body flourish only; no waving hand
later_states.POINTING: use ribbon tip/orientation or UI highlight; no finger/hand
